name: Evening Formula
headline: Evening Formula
description: Lemon balm, hops and St John's wort extracts with the calming mineral magnesium and the amino acid theanine. Together they have a mild soothing effect on the nervous system and help make falling asleep easier.
howToUse: Adults – 1 capsule once a day with food, in the second half of the day.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Theanine, lemon balm leaf extract, hop flower extract, St John's wort extract, magnesium, skullcap root extract, excipients.

rows.name: St. John wort (Hypericum perforatum) herb extract
